title: Customer Insights - Journeys: Journey Creation Agent builds journeys from a plain-language description
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents an API setting for AI prompts, so the table incorrectly reports that automation is not documented. The roadmap facts and the credit-allocation API are supported; qualifications about regional controls, licensing and capacity overages also need attention.

claims.claim: Journey Creation Agent is an AI assistant in Customer Insights - Journeys that builds journey structures from natural language descriptions.
claims.quote: Journey Creation Agent is an AI-powered assistant in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys that lets you build customer journey structures through natural language conversation.

claims.claim: The proposed journey includes steps, timing and branching logic.
claims.quote: Describe your journey in conversational language and the agent proposes a journey structure with steps, timing, and branching logic.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents this feature as preview, so its documented behaviour is not final.
claims.quote: [This article is prerelease documentation and is subject to change.]

claims.claim: Journey Creation Agent replaces the previously released Journey Copilot for journey creation.
claims.quote: Journey Creation Agent replaces the previously released Journey Copilot for journey creation.

claims.claim: The agent assembles journeys using segments and content assets already in the environment.
claims.quote: The agent works with segments and content assets that already exist in your Customer Insights - Journeys environment.

claims.claim: The agent does not create segments in this release.
claims.quote: It assembles those assets into a logical journey flow; it doesn't create segments or write content for you in this release.

claims.claim: The agent does not write content in this release.
claims.quote: It assembles those assets into a logical journey flow; it doesn't create segments or write content for you in this release.

claims.claim: The agent shows a visual journey preview before publication.
claims.quote: Before you publish, the agent presents a visual preview of the proposed journey.

claims.claim: Review and refine opens the proposed journey in the standard journey designer.
claims.quote: When the proposed structure looks right, select Review and refine in the agent panel. The journey opens on the standard journey canvas with all proposed steps, conditions, and content assignments populated.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Nothing goes live until a person approves the journey and publishes it as usual.
claims.quote: Nothing goes live until you approve it. ... When the journey structure is correct, you can publish the journey as you usually would.

claims.claim: Proposed journeys must be reviewed on the journey designer before publishing.
claims.quote: Every journey proposed by the agent must be reviewed on the canvas before it can go live.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/customer-insights/journeys/faqs-journey-creation-agent to sources; it explicitly documents mandatory canvas review.

claims.claim: Journey Creation Agent is currently available only in English.
claims.quote: Journey Creation Agent is currently available only in English.

claims.claim: Learn says North America and Oceania customers get Journey Creation Agent with the June 2026 update.
claims.quote: If you're a customer in the North America (NAM) or Oceania (OCE) region, Journey Creation Agent will be available to you with the June 2026 update.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The feature is admin-opt-in and requires administrator enablement before use.
claims.quote: To use AI agents in Customer Insights – Journeys, a tenant administrator must first enable AI agents at the tenant level in the Power Platform Admin Center.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Journey Creation Agent uses Anthropic models.
claims.quote: Journey Creation Agent uses Anthropic's models.

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; Governance guidance; controls[4].note
claims.claim: Anthropic must be allowed in both the Microsoft 365 and Power Platform admin centres.
claims.quote: Ensure your tenant is opted in through the Microsoft 365 admin center and Power Platform Admin Center to allow Anthropic to be used.

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot Studio capacity, Move data across regions and AI prompts are the three required AI Hub prerequisites.
claims.quote: The following prerequisites must be reviewed and accepted: Microsoft Copilot Studio capacity; Move data across regions; AI prompts.

claims.claim: AI agent data might be processed and stored outside the user's primary region.
claims.quote: This means agent data might be processed and stored in regions outside the user's primary region, depending on service and infrastructure availability.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Anthropic models in Microsoft Copilot and Power Platform are excluded from the EU Data Boundary.
claims.quote: Claude models deployed in Microsoft offerings such as Microsoft Copilot, Researcher, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary

claims.claim: Prompts containing personally identifiable information or sensitive data may be blocked.
claims.quote: Prompts that contain personally identifiable information (PII) or sensitive data may be blocked.

claims.claim: Users can use only segments and content assets their accounts have permission to access.
claims.quote: You can only use segments and content assets that your user account has permission to access.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Creating and publishing journeys requires Marketing Manager, Marketing Professional or equivalent permissions.
claims.quote: A Marketing Manager or Marketing Professional role, or equivalent permissions are required to create and publish journeys.

claims.claim: AI Hub is available to users with the Admin role by default.
claims.quote: AI Hub is available to users with the Admin role by default.

claims.claim: Custom roles need agent settings permissions for the msdynmkt_agentsettings entity.
claims.quote: If you use custom roles and permissions, add agent settings permissions for the msdynmkt_agentsettings entity.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admins can restrict AI provider access to specific users or Microsoft Entra ID security groups.
claims.quote: You can restrict user access to AI provider subprocessors by assigning permissions to specific users or Microsoft Entra ID security groups in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: The Anthropic page says only assigned users can use Copilot features or agents relying on a provider when provider access is restricted.
claims.quote: When access is limited by user or group membership, only the assigned users can use Copilot features or agents that rely on that AI provider.

claims.claim: The agent may match a similarly named segment or trigger.
claims.quote: The agent may have matched a similarly named asset in your environment. Review the entry settings and replace the segment or trigger with the correct one.

claims.claim: The agent may omit steps for channels that are not configured.
claims.quote: If you referenced a channel not yet configured (for example, push notifications when no push app is set up), the agent may omit those steps.

claims.claim: Journeys can start from Dynamics 365 Sales events.
claims.quote: You can describe journeys that start from events in Dynamics 365 Sales

claims.claim: Journeys can start from Dynamics 365 Customer Service events.
claims.quote: Journeys can start from service events such as case creation or resolution, supporting post-service follow-up and customer retention scenarios.

claims.claim: Sales and Customer Service integrations require those applications to be part of the deployment.
claims.quote: Integration with Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service requires that those applications are part of your Dynamics 365 deployment

claims.claim: An administrator must configure the relevant Sales and Customer Service connections.
claims.quote: the relevant connections are configured by your administrator.

claims.claim: Microsoft says the preview is not meant for production use.
claims.quote: Preview features aren’t meant for production use and might have restricted functionality.

claims.claim: Refreshing the creation experience discards the current proposal.
claims.quote: Refreshing the page while on the creation experience discards the current proposal.

claims.claim: Work is preserved on refresh if Review and refine already transferred the proposal to the journey builder.
claims.quote: If the proposal was already transferred to the journey builder by selecting Review and refine, your work is preserved.

claims.claim: Withdrawing a mandatory prerequisite automatically disables enabled agents until it is accepted again.
claims.quote: If any mandatory prerequisite is no longer accepted in the Power Platform Admin Center: All enabled agents are automatically disabled. Agents remain unavailable until the prerequisite is accepted again.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and cost; summary; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Journey Creation Agent consumes Copilot credits, supporting consumption licensing and variable cost.
claims.quote: Journey Creation Agent uses Copilot credits.

claims.claim: AI Hub describes agents as available out of the box and consuming Copilot credits.
claims.quote: Agents are available out of the box and consume Copilot credits.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Customer Insights - Journeys AI capabilities support prepaid capacity using Copilot Studio message pack subscriptions.
claims.quote: Prepaid capacity: Uses Copilot Studio message pack subscriptions, which are a licensing option for Microsoft Copilot Studio that you purchase in advance.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go charges for the actual messages agents consume during the month.
claims.quote: Pay-as-you-go: Charges for the actual number of messages consumed by agents during the month.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The Journey Creation Agent feature page's prerequisites name permissions and AI Hub enablement but no separate licence.
claims.quote: Enable Journey Creation Agent using AI Hub. ... A Marketing Manager or Marketing Professional role, or equivalent permissions are required to create and publish journeys.
claims.fix: Keep the narrowly attributed observation, but append: 'The responsible AI FAQ separately says Journey Creation Agent requires a Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys license.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/customer-insights/journeys/faqs-journey-creation-agent.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; Open questions
claims.claim: A feature-specific credits-per-journey rate is not published as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "Journey Creation Agent" "credits" "rate"; "Journey Creation Agent" "pricing". Opened journey-creation-agent, ai-hub-prerequisites, Copilot Studio billing-licensing and requirements-messages-management; no journey-specific rate.

claims.claim: A price specific to creating one journey is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Journey Creation Agent" "pricing" and "Journey Creation Agent" "credits" "rate". Opened feature, prerequisites, Copilot Studio licensing and billing-rates pages; no per-journey price.

claims.claim: Administrators allocate Copilot Studio capacity to the Customer Insights - Journeys environment in Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: Before using AI agents, administrators need to make sure enough Copilot Studio capacity is allocated to the environment. Capacity allocation is managed in the Power Platform Admin Center.

claims.claim: AI Hub tells administrators to configure message consumption limits to control Journey Creation Agent usage.
claims.quote: To control agent usage, configure message consumption limits. For more information, see Manage capacity.

claims.claim: The allocation tutorial says Draw from the available capacity in my tenant permits tenant-pool overages when selected and caps the environment at its allocation when cleared.
claims.quote: Selected: after the environment's allocated credits are consumed, it continues to draw from your tenant's unallocated capacity. Cleared: the environment is capped at its allocation and stops consuming when the allocation is exhausted.
claims.fix: Add: 'The capacity-management page also documents a separate Bill to my pay-as-you-go billing plan overage option; only when no overage source is enabled can an environment consume only its allocated prepaid credits.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/manage-copilot-studio-messages-capacity.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; controls[2].note; Open questions
claims.claim: The linked allocation controls do not establish an unconditional feature-specific spend cap for this agent.
claims.quote: Searched: "Journey Creation Agent" "credits" "rate". Opened AI Hub, prerequisites, manage-copilot-studio-messages-capacity and allocation tutorial; allocation is documented, but no unconditional Journey Creation Agent spend-cap guarantee.

claims.claim: The cited feature and prerequisite pages state no separate cost for data movement or allowing Anthropic.
claims.quote: Searched: "Journey Creation Agent" "pricing". Read journey-creation-agent, ai-hub-prerequisites, connect-to-ai-subprocessor and allow-llm-generative-responses; these pages state no separate cost for allowing Anthropic or cross-region movement.

claims.claim: Journey Creation Agent requires update 1.1.65002.153.
claims.quote: Journey Creation Agent is available as part of the 1.1.65002.153 update. To use Journey Creation Agent, navigate to Settings > Versions and upgrade to 1.1.65002.153.

claims.claim: Settings > Versions is the documented update path.
claims.quote: To use Journey Creation Agent, navigate to Settings > Versions and upgrade to 1.1.65002.153.

claims.claim: Microsoft's pages link to availability reports for geographic and language availability.
claims.quote: Learn more about the languages that are supported in the Copilot international availability report.

claims.claim: Claude models are unavailable to federal GCC customers and all GCC High and DoD customers.
claims.quote: Claude models aren't available for federal customers in GCC or for any customers in GCC High and Department of Defense (DoD) environments.

claims.quote: If a tenant administrator disables AI agents in the Power Platform Admin Center: All active agents are immediately disabled.

claims.quote: New agents can't be created or configured.

claims.quote: In AI Hub, go to Add and manage agents. Select the agent. Set the agent status to Disabled.

claims.quote: Enabling a provider in Microsoft 365 doesn't automatically make its models available in Power Platform.

claims.claim: A Power Platform system admin allows a provider's models in environments or environment groups.
claims.quote: Then, a Power Platform system admin allows the provider's models in an environment or environment group.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys > AI agents > Use AI agents enables agents for a selected environment or environment group.
claims.quote: Go to Power Platform Admin Center > Copilot > Settings. ... Scroll to the Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Journeys section. Select AI agents. Set Use AI agents to On for the selected environment or environment group.

claims.claim: No automation operation is documented for the Customer Insights - Journeys Use AI agents control.
claims.quote: Searched: "Use AI agents" "API" "Journeys"; "Use AI agents" "Set-TenantSettings" "pac". Read AI Hub, tenant-settings, pac admin and Set-TenantSettings excerpts; no operation or setting key for this switch.

claims.claim: Enable Journey Creation Agent through Settings > AI Hub > Add and manage agents > Add an agent > Journey Creation Agent > Overview tab > Enable.
claims.quote: To open AI Hub, go to Settings and select AI Hub ... In AI Hub, select Add and manage agents. Select Add an agent and choose Journey Creation Agent. In the Overview tab, review how the agent works. ... To activate the agent, select Enable.

claims.claim: No documented automation operation enables Journey Creation Agent in AI Hub.
claims.quote: Searched: "Customer Insights" "AI agents" "API" "msdynmkt_agentsettings"; "msdynmkt_agentsettings" "Web API"; "msdynmkt_agentsetting" "Enable". Read AI Hub and msdyn_agentsetting excerpts; the latter is a different entity.

claims.claim: Credit allocations are managed at Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Licensing. Under Products, select Copilot Studio, and then select Manage Copilot Credits. ... Select the environment that you want to manage.

claims.claim: PUT /licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 with environmentId, allocatedEntitlements, MCSMessages, allocation.quantity and TenantPool enabled:false writes the allocation and disables tenant-pool draw.
claims.quote: $apiVersion = "2024-10-01" ... scope = @{ environmentId = $environmentId } ... entitlementId = "MCSMessages" ... allocation = @{ quantity = 5000 } ... @{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false } ... Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put

claims.claim: Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator can manage credit allocations.
claims.quote: Sign in as a user with the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Settings > View all > AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors > Available subprocessors for your organization > Anthropic is the provider opt-in path.
claims.quote: select Copilot > Settings > View all. ... Select AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors. ... under Available subprocessors for your organization, select Anthropic, and Save.

claims.claim: No Microsoft Graph or other documented automation operation configures this Microsoft 365 Anthropic provider setting.
claims.quote: Searched: "Anthropic" "settings" "Graph" "API" admin; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph "Anthropic" "provider" "settings". Opened connect-to-ai-subprocessor; returned provider-management passages give UI controls, not an API.

claims.claim: AI Administrator or Global Administrator can configure the Microsoft 365 Anthropic setting.
claims.quote: You must be a member of the AI Administrator or Global Administrator role to perform this task.

claims.claim: Power Platform provider settings are under Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features.
claims.quote: select Manage. ... select Environments, and then select the environment. ... select Settings. ... select Product > Features. ... turn each applicable model provider setting On or Off.

claims.claim: No documented automation operation controls Power Platform Anthropic availability.
claims.quote: Searched: "Power Platform" "Anthropic" "API" "PowerShell"; "Power Platform Anthropic" "API" "rules"; organization entity "Anthropic". Read allow-llm-generative-responses, API-reference excerpts and organization properties; no matching operation.

claims.claim: Environment groups can govern Anthropic through the Power Platform Anthropic rule.
claims.quote: Power Platform Anthropic | Controls Power Platform Anthropic models.

claims.claim: The prerequisite page documents Manage > Environments > environment > Generative AI features > Edit > Move data across regions.
claims.quote: select Manage. ... Select Environments. ... select the target environment. ... locate the Generative AI features card and select Edit. ... Select the Move data across regions checkbox.
claims.fix: Add to this row's note: 'The platform data-movement page says this checkbox is not displayed for environments in U.S. or government cloud regions.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/geographical-availability-copilot.

claims.claim: No documented automation operation is provided for accepting Move data across regions for this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: "Move data across regions" "PowerShell" "API"; "Move data across regions" "Power Platform API" "CrossGeoCopilotDataMovement". Read prerequisites, geographical-availability-copilot, SDK enum excerpt and organization properties; no complete operation.

claims.claim: AI prompts is controlled under Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > AI Builder > AI prompts.
claims.quote: select Environments > [select an environment] > Settings > Product > Features. ... under AI Builder, enable the AI prompts toggle. ... you can also govern the AI prompts feature availability through the AI prompts environment group rule.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no API for the AI prompts setting and credit allocation is the table's only documented API.
claims.quote: Entity set path: [organization URI]/api/data/v9.2/organizations ... Operations supported: GET PATCH ... aipromptsenabled | Edm.Boolean | Indicates whether AI Prompts feature is enabled.
claims.fix: Replace controls[6].api null with kind 'rest', call 'PATCH <organization-uri>/api/data/v9.2/organizations(<organization-id>) {"aipromptsenabled":true}', docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/webapi/reference/organization'. The writable AiPromptsEnabled attribute is also documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/reference/entities/organization#aipromptsenabled and PATCH semantics at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/webapi/update-delete-entities-using-web-api. Replace the final Governance controls sentence with: 'Microsoft documents a Dataverse Web API setting for AI prompts as well as the Power Platform API for credit allocation; no automation operation was found for the other settings at the time of writing (November 2026).'

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated what tenant defaults or enablement steps will change at the April CY2027 general availability target.
claims.quote: Searched: "Journey Creation Agent" "general availability" "default". Read roadmap, journey-creation-agent, AI Hub and prerequisites; these document the preview and do not specify changed tenant defaults at general availability.

claims.claim: An environment group rule can govern AI prompts availability.
claims.quote: If your environment is part of an environment group, you can also govern the AI prompts feature availability through the AI prompts environment group rule.
